attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Virginia state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Va. Code § 58.1-320: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 5.75%. Standard deductions: $8,500 Single/MFS, $17,000 MFJ/QSS, $8,500 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Virginia Tax Calculation (top marginal 5.75%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Virginia Tax Calculation (top marginal 5.75%)" job.audit_trail swap addto swap addto
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Virginia Tax Calculation (top marginal 5.75%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 17000.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.0575
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 17000.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.0575 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " VA MFJ taxable income (AGI - $17,000): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " VA state tax (5.75%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
